constraints: Dates are serialized as "yyyy-mm-dd" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ" text depending on the current database date setting.
Numbers must fall within ±10.421e±10; Booleans serialize as the literal strings "true"/"false"; times serialize as a Real number of seconds by default.
Picture attributes are converted to the literal string "[object Picture]" (not real picture data).
Pointers to a field, variable, or array are evaluated (dereferenced) before being stringified.
The optional * parameter enables pretty-printing (adds formatting whitespace) in the resulting string.
